description: Template: a READ-ONLY Qualys credential for one subscription. Use a user with the Reader role and API Access only (no UI access), scoped in Qualys to the asset groups or tags that hold the in-scope AWS hosts. Copy to qualys-<name>.secret.json under a private TAP_SECRETS_ROOT, set key to match the file name, and replace every REPLACE_WITH value. Never commit the filled-in copy.
